card.what: Burger Studio turns the FM-1 into a sampler workstation, built on Felucca: a SAMPLE row on HOME with its own sampling and sample FX, a guitar-pedal-style looper (tap to overdub, hold to undo the last layer) and ROCK LIVE, a real rock kit for slicing. It comes with free Android apps: Burger Studio makes beats with the same sounds and sends samples to the FM-1, and 16 Track mixes and records the parts.
